text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGE: High 5xx ratio observed for /v1/generate on hosted-api (alert id: alert-8237). Current 5m error rate: 23%. Paging on-call.

Alex P: oncall here, looking now. which clusters?

IncidentBot: Affected target: hosted-us-east-1 pool (redwood-hosted-prod). Alerts triggered at 2026-03-15T09:14:38Z.

Maria G: I'm seeing customer reports from two customers on the dashboard. CX ticket #8765 mentions timeouts for streaming.

Samir: grabbing logs from frontend LB and gateway. Pulling last 30m.

Infra Ops: FYI there was an autoscaler change today at 02:00 UTC (scaled policy tweak for p99 latency headroom) — could be related.

Alex P: good to note. Samir, paste the gateway error snippet when you have it.

Samir: copying logs:```
[09:12:41] gateway-1 - 502 Bad Gateway - backend timeout
[09:12:42] runtime-2 - 504 Upstream read timeout after 30s
[09:13:05] model-proxy-5 - ERR: KV cache overflow, drop request
```

Maria G: customers seeing partial streams then disconnects. Important: model responses sometimes continue server-side; clients hit socket close.

Julie: starting impact assessment. How many calls/sec affected?

Evan L: current QPS to /v1/generate for hosted pool: 420rps, errors ~95rps => ~23%. Error is spiking for sequences > 1024 tokens.

Ryan H: Hypothesis 1: autoscaler change reduced spare capacity -> longer queueing -> upstream timeouts on long sequences.

Samir: Hypothesis 2: recent runtime patch (edge kv cache eviction tweak) at 06:50 could be causing KV cache overflow on large sequences.

Alex P: Let's track hypotheses inline: H1 autoscaler, H2 kv-cache change, H3 model variant rollout bumped to quantized variant with new kernel causing stalls. Owners?

Maria G: I'll own customer comms & impact tracking.

Julie: I'll own metrics/timeline build.

Samir: I'll dig into runtime patch and logs; I can run targeted repros.

Infra Ops: I'll check autoscaler policy diff and look at recent node churn.

IncidentBot: ACTIONS: @Samir run repro, @Infra Ops review scaler diff, @Alex P consider scoped mitigation.

Alex P: Mitigation plan: 1) throttle long-sequence requests temporarily (set max_sequence to 1024 for hosted catalog) 2) if that doesn't drop error rate in 10m, roll back autoscaler tweak to previous policy, 3) standby for runtime revert. Which can we do fast?

Infra Ops: I can revert scaler change immediately — it's a config flip in infra-config repo. Rollback window ~2 minutes. But that may increase costs; need approval.

Samir: Running repro against model-proxy with inputs of 1500-2000 tokens. Command:```bash
curl -X POST https://hosted-us-east-1.internal/v1/generate -d '{"input":"<long prompt>"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -v
```
I'll gather kernel logs.

(5 min passes)

Samir: repro shows KV eviction churn when sequence > 1200, CPU spikes on model-proxy. Stack: model-proxy -> runtime -> kernel call blocked. Paste stack sample:```
EPOCH 2026-03-15T09:19:12Z runtime: kv_cache_evict:5
runtime: enqueue request id=abc123 size=1500
kernel: select_impl: waiting on resource, latency 220ms
```

Alex P: That leans H2. But autoscaler could amplify. Maria, any enterprise customers impacted (SLA)?

Maria G: Two enterprise customers reporting timeouts: AcmePay and NoteCloud. Both on Dedicated? AcmePay on Dedicated, NoteCloud hosted — only NoteCloud affected. AcmePay unaffected. We'll open priority ticket to NoteCloud.

Ryan H: Quick scoped mitigation: patch model-proxy to enforce per-connection streaming keepalive and accept backpressure instead of dropping. That takes ~30-45m to deploy. Faster: throttle long sequences at gateway (Alex's suggestion) — can be applied as header-based policy in API gateway in ~5 min.

Alex P: Do throttling now. Infra Ops, please apply gateway rule to cap sequences > 1024 to 10rps per IP and return 429 with friendly message.

Infra Ops: applying rule now. Config commit id: cfg-9a7b.```diff
+ gateway: route /v1/generate -> header check: if x-seq-len > 1024 return 429
```
Deployed in 00:02.

(3 min)

Evan L: after throttle rollout, error rate fell to 9% and downstream timeouts dropped by half. Good signal.

Julie: timeline so far: 09:14 alert -> 09:15 page -> 09:18 repro -> 09:23 throttle deployed -> 09:26 partial recovery. I'll capture full timeline in postmortem.

Samir: I still see some KV eviction logs. Possible long-term fix: increase cache capacity / change eviction policy.

Alex P: Decision: keep throttle in place for now. Next steps: run controlled rollback of autoscaler tweak in staging, but don't flip in prod yet. Create experiment plan to revert runtime patch in a canary subset (10% of traffic) to verify H2. Owners: Samir (runtime revert), Infra Ops (canary rollout), Julie (metrics monitor).

Maria G: Sending brief to affected customer NoteCloud: "we have deployed a temporary throttle to reduce timeouts for long responses while we investigate. We'll follow up within 2 hours with status."

Ryan H: Experiment runbook:
1) create canary label on 5 instances mapping to model-proxy-old (pre-patch)
2) route 10% of new traffic to canary for 30m
3) monitor 5xx rate, latency, KV eviction logs
4) if 5xx drops by >50%, plan staged rollback

Samir: starting build of pre-patch runtime image. ETA 20m.

Infra Ops: prepping terraform change for canary routing. Do we want to test on a single zone first?

Alex P: yes, single zone (us-east-1a). Keep outbound customer traffic unaffected (route only internal test tokens + small share of live traffic). Use feature flag to revert quickly.

(20 min)

Samir: pre-patch image built: img-runt-2026-03-15-06. Reverting runtime on 4 canary nodes now.

IncidentBot: NOTE: Pagerduty handoff scheduled at 10:00 UTC to next on-call (Evan L).

Evan L: oncall takeover acknowledged, I'll watch the canary metric window.

Julie: after canary deployment metrics: canary 5xx 2%, prod baseline 9%. KV eviction logs reduced for canary. Strong signal for H2.

Alex P: Good. Authorize staged rollback? We should coordinate with cost control and schedule. If rollback reduces errors without negative regressions, we'll plan a safe revert.

Infra Ops: prepare PR to rollback runtime patch globally with a staged rollout. I'll include a revert flag.

Samir: I'll run the regression test suite to confirm no perf regressions on small sequences.

Maria G: I'll draft the incident note for customers: summary, mitigation (throttle), next steps (runtime revert canary success), ETA for full resolution (TBD but aiming 4 hours).

Alex P: Closing normal-urgency channel for now: monitoring in place, throttle maintained, canary shows positive signal. Postmortem owners: Julie (timeline), Samir (root cause analysis), Maria (customer comms). I will file the incident ticket and link this thread.

IncidentBot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-158. Please update ticket with findings and todos.

Samir: quick note — need approval to increase KV cache as a longer-term mitigation. I'll prepare a proposal.

Ryan H: assign follow-ups:
- run performance benchmarks on pre/post runtime (Samir)
- autoscaler policy review (Infra Ops)
- customer followups and SLA notes (Maria)
- postmortem doc (Julie)

Alex P: thanks everyone. Keep updates in the ticket. If error rate creeps above 12% re-pager to high.

Maria G: posted update to NoteCloud support ticket. They replied: thanks for quick mitigation, will monitor.

(Thread ends at 10:12 UTC)
